management.title: Index Management
management.rebuildConfirmMessage: Rebuilding the index will delete all existing index data and resync all knowledge documents. This operation may take a long time, and the search service will be temporarily unavailable. Are you sure you want to continue?
management.syncSuccess: Full sync completed! Success: {{success}} items, Failed: {{failed}} items
management.rebuildSuccess: Index rebuild completed! Success: {{success}} items, Failed: {{failed}} items
management.syncFailed: Full sync failed, please try again later
management.rebuildFailed: Index rebuild failed, please try again later
management.managementDescription: Manage search indexes, including full sync and rebuilding indexes. Rebuilding indexes deletes existing indexes and resyncs all documents, suitable for when index configuration changes or data is corrupted. Full sync only adds missing documents, faster.
management.syncAllDescription: Only syncs documents that exist in the database but not in the index, does not affect existing index data, fast, search service available.
management.rebuildIndexDescription: Deletes the entire index then recreates and full syncs, slow, search service unavailable during the process. Only use when index configuration changes or data is corrupted.
